journey.name: TL-05 Deleting a task removes it and announces it
journey.description:
Covers FR-04 and the first half of FR-12. The delete must reach the source: the cache is only updated on success, so a failed delete never removes the row in the first place (BACKLOG.md Q-2).
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that "Book dentist" is no longer in the list
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Verify that an "Undo" action is offered next to that message
Verify that exactly three elements with the content description "Delete task" remain on screen
